reviews.body: ## Pull request overview Adds a new `transformerless::transitions` module for compiling forward region-transition edges and constructing a reverse edge index intended to satisfy Theorem 7, along with integration tests and module wiring. **Changes:** - Introduces `TransitionGraph` with forward edges and a reverse index (`reverse_index` + `reverse_offsets`) plus a Theorem 7 verifier. - Implements `compile_transitions_from_corpus` to aggregate per-(src,dst) transition weights from the teacher `Corpus`, apply a per-node cap, and build the reverse index. - Adds integration tests covering manual graph construction, synthetic corpus compilation, and per-node transition bounding. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | crates/uor-r4-core/src/transformerless/transitions.rs | New transition-graph data structures, reverse indexing, and corpus-based compilation. | | crates/uor-r4-core/tests/transitions_test.rs | New tests validating reverse-index construction, Theorem 7 checks, and bounding behavior. | | crates/uor-r4-core/src/transformerless/mod.rs | Exposes the new `transitions` module on non-wasm targets. | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews. Learn how to get started.

review_comments.body: `transitions_by_src` is a `HashMap`, so iterating `for (src, mut dsts) in transitions_by_src` makes canonical edge ID assignment depend on randomized hash iteration order. That makes edge IDs (and thus `reverse_index`) non-deterministic across runs, which is risky for reproducible compilation artifacts.

`verify_theorem_7` currently only checks that offsets point to edges with the expected `dst`, but it does not actually verify the stated/specified property that `reverse_index` is sorted by destination (nor that `reverse_offsets` covers the whole `reverse_index`). This can return Ok even if `reverse_index` is unsorted or partially indexed.
